notes.title: Update #3 – Your Greatest Challenge Yet!
notes.notes:
[h2]This is the biggest update to the demo so far – and here’s why:[/h2]

[h3] Battle Against the First Demon Lord Officer[/h3]
You can now face the strongest enemy in the demo to date – the First Officer of the Demon Lord. We’ve teased him before, and now the time has come. The fight is fast-paced, intense, and action-packed – a true test of your reflexes and skill.

[h3]New Difficulty Selection[/h3]
Before entering the portal to fight either the Demon Boss (returning from earlier versions) or the Officer, you'll now choose your difficulty:
🔹 Normal
🔹 Hard
Your choice affects the challenge… and the reward.

[h3]Save System Added[/h3]
By popular demand, we’ve added a save system! Now you can keep your progress and try different approaches without losing everything.

[h3] Improved Gunplay[/h3]
We’ve updated the shooting mechanics – it’s now faster, smoother, and more responsive. Every weapon feels better to use.

[h3] New Music[/h3]
We’ve replaced some tracks and added original compositions.

Thanks for your support, feedback, and suggestions – the game keeps getting better because of you!
Let us know how you fared against the new boss, and which difficulty you chose! 

Add the game to your wishlist, follow us on Steam, and join our Discord to stay updated and hang out with the devs and community!

notes.title: Update #2 – Even More Action Based on Your Feedback!
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for all the feedback after the first update – it’s been incredibly helpful! Based on your input, we’ve prepared a new set of changes to make the gameplay more dynamic and enjoyable. Here’s what’s new:

🐻 More action!
– Boss fights are now more intense and dynamic. 
– Additional enemies now appear along the routes between objectives. 
– Extra bears spawn in villages during the boss encounter.

🔫 Combat and balance improvements
– Enemies that are resistant to a specific elemental weapon now display shield indicators when hit. 
– It is no longer possible to kill enemies through portals. 
– The pistol is now set to single-shot mode, as originally intended. 
[b]– Fixed a bug that caused slow firing speed for the pistol on some systems. [/b]
– Weapon range rebalanced (pistol and rifle). 

🗺️ UI and dialogue improvements
– Goddess portraits now appear during their mission-related dialogue. 
– Side dialogues take up less space on screen. 
– Most dialogues can now be skipped.
– Objective locators are more visible and easier to follow.
– Shop and weapon loading tutorial has been improved – clearer and more helpful.

🏃‍♂️ Player parameter balance
– Adjusted values for: height, stamina, jump, and dash.

And this is just the beginning – more updates are on the way! 🚀
If you haven’t already, add the game to your wishlist – and don’t forget to join our Discord to share feedback, chat with other players, and stay up to date! 💬

notes.title: Update #1 – First updates Based on Your Feedback!
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who played Isekai: I'm an FPS Hero and shared their thoughts with us! 💌 Your feedback is invaluable – here’s what we’ve already improved:

🔤 Fixed fonts – special characters in various languages (e.g., Ukrainian) now display correctly.
⚙️ New settings menu! – we’ve added basic options: Audio, Quality, and Keymapping (currently view-only – key remapping will come in a future update!).
🔫 Faster pistol firing – the early-game combat feels more dynamic.
🗿 Fixed stone projectiles – rocks thrown by the cute-but-deadly bears no longer roll on the ground and deal unintended damage.
💎 Easier core collection – no more jumping to collect floating cores – just walk underneath them.
❤️ Bigger enemy health bars – improved visibility during combat.
⚡ Faster stamina regeneration – more action, less waiting.
👹 Nymaria boss updated – on your second visit to the region, the boss will now notice you faster and summon reinforcements more quickly. No more easy sniping from afar!

This is just the beginning – more updates are on the way! Thank you for your continued support and please keep sharing your thoughts – we're building this world together! 🌍✨

notes.title: 🌸 Dev Log #2 — Arcadia: The Island of Blessings
notes.notes:
Before we start blasting demons and casting spells like maniacs, we’d love to take you on a chill stroll through one of the islands in the Arcadian archipelago — one that hasn’t yet been consumed by chaos and evil creatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538251/f1d5a8ba3beb75d096a4d57e07230431e0f3e85c.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]🌿 Welcome to Nymaria, Midori’s favorite island[/h3][/b]
Midori — the goddess of nature, weather, and the elements — has a soft spot for this place. As she puts it:
[i]"Even the rain here tastes like lemonade."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538251/226e2c9dabe42ff0345a9031bcf8775a1b933946.jpg[/img]
It's her favorite place. That's why the weather is always nice, [b]the island's residents are happy[/b], crops grow on their own, and [b]the teddies[/b] dance in praise of each new day.

There are three villages on the island, where locals honor the goddesses — but one in particular gets most of the love.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538251/a851677890b7838cbd56a7a1d7f38db1f33bb504.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]🧸 Life here? A total fairytale![/h3][/b]
So far… everyone’s living their best life. Midori handles the weather, Riskia takes care of trade, and Riza… well, she’s not like the others, but the villagers know they can count on her when it matters..

Evil hasn’t arrived yet. The portals haven’t opened.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538251/53f37873e957922e94efa765dc39cf0fbc1ed1ec.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]💚 Will you stay with us a little longer?[/h3][/b]
If you want to be around when things start hinting at the rise of the Demon Lord:

notes.title: 🎮 Welcome to ISEKAI: I'm an FPS Hero who was summoned to another world 🎮
notes.notes:
We’re excited to finally show you the game we’re working on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538251/5ac36f488c4b706ccdded84c921f6313d2675fe7.gif[/img]
ISEKAI: I'm an FPS Hero who was summoned to another world is a fusion of fast-paced FPS action and anime aesthetics, set in a wild world where adorable creatures turn into wicked, grotesquely amusing monsters, and the only hope for salvation is… well, an FPS player who got isekai’d by accident.

🔹 What is ISEKAI: I'm an FPS Hero..?
As a hardcore FPS player, you are accidentally summoned to another world by a clumsy goddess of gambling, shopping, and fun. Your mission? Destroy the portals, stop the demon invasion, and uncover the truth behind the chaos.

Here’s what awaits you:
🔫 Intense FPS combat against demon officers, the minions of the Demon Lord, and the very inhabitants of Arcadia – whose souls have been corrupted by dark forces!
🔥 A weapon upgrade system that lets you fuse monster cores with your guns!
⚔️ Epic boss fights, leading up to the Demon Lord himself!
💖 Goddesses with unique (and often chaotic) personalities – some will help you, others have their own plans…
🛒 A special ability – online shopping! Because who said you can’t order real-world guns in another dimension?

🔹 What’s next?
This is just the beginning! From now on, we’ll regularly share updates on our progress, including behind-the-scenes content, gameplay details, and first looks at key mechanics.

[h2]We want you to be part of this journey – [b]follow our page, add the game to your wishlist[/b], and join our community![/h2]

💬What are your first impressions? Let us know in the comments – we’d love to hear your thoughts!

[h3]📢 JOIN US ON DISCORD![/h3]
Want to chat with us and other players? Join our Discord server for exclusive content, discussions about the game, and direct interaction with the devs!
https://discord.gg/SxQg5thNZQ

See you in Arcadia, heroes!
